name: Auto Update Page Links
author: mirfan439

sections.description:
• Updates page/post content
  • Updates navigation menus (wp_navigation)
  • Updates block templates (wp_template)
  • Updates template parts (wp_template_part)
  • Logs to /wp-content/uploads/auto-update-page-links/auto-update-links.log
sections.changelog:
3.1.0

  • Move logs to uploads directory via wp_upload_dir()
  • Replace short prefix with unique auplinks
  • Use plugin_dir_path()/plugin_dir_url() and gmdate()
  • Minor hardening and code cleanup

3.0

  • Full site coverage + logging

2.0

  • Add templates/template parts support

1.0

  • Initial release

short_description: Updates internal links (menus, content, templates) automatically when you change a page slug/URL. Logs are stored in the uploads directory.
description:

  • Updates template parts (wp_template_part)
  • Logs to /wp-content/uploads/auto-update-page-links/auto-update-links.log
